```NEW: added PJS, just copy your lvls and past

and WW countdown calc for it(more smithing)

Balloon calc for Cooking

EXP calc for Construction, Active alchemy(may be wrong), Smithing,  Laboratory

Egg and EXP calc for Breeding

Mantra and EXP calc for Divinity

Family and EXP calc for Summoning(wrong )

Calc for Trapping and Sneaking```
